decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established finishing portfolio with its own product page, it likely meets a minimum aspiration level and the firm has enough slack to keep learning from the launch.

Because the UV spot varnishing system is more distant from the core offer, its fit and results are more uncertain, but the prominent launch and a growing market make management more likely to continue than to withdraw it immediately.

This sheet preparation module builds directly on existing capabilities, so comparable-firm and historical aspirations are easier to satisfy and there is little reason for problemistic exit after such a recent launch.

The B2-format multifinisher is close to the core business, strategically aligned with broader format flexibility and automation, and its home-page launch suggests enough importance to keep it on the market.
A hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's established postpress range, and without clear signs of severe underperformance management would typically retain it while sales evidence accumulates.
The folding add-on unit already shows a concrete customer use case on the website, indicating early market validation that should place it above aspiration and make withdrawal unlikely.
